_mcpNote: n8n (Hermes VPS, webhook.digitalravagers.in/mcp-server/http) and Voicenotes are wired as account-level connectors in Claude Code — they appear automatically in-session as mcp__n8n__* / mcp__Voicenotes__* tools, no local credentials needed. The mcpServers block below is a project-local fallback only for harnesses without that account connector (e.g. a bare self-hosted Claude Code CLI); leave disabled unless running in such an environment.

n8n._activate: Only needed outside the account-connector environment. Get N8N_API_URL + N8N_API_KEY from Hermes VPS → n8n dashboard → Settings → API, then set disabled:false

voicenotes._activate: Only needed outside the account-connector environment. Get VOICENOTES_API_KEY from voicenotes.com → Settings → API, then set disabled:false
